searchText: MSRP $221,300. New 2025 Leisure Travel Wonder 24MBL Features Dual Reclining Chairs Leisure Lounge System Truma Varioheat Furnace Lithium Batteries Upgrade Solar Panels - Rigid Low Profile with Control Panel - 400 Watt Macerator - Termination with Manual Disconnect Exterior Table Exterior Entertainment Package More About This RV The slide out in this coach will give you plenty of space to relax! You will find that the Murphy bed will provide a great night's rest each night, and the full bath will allow you to clean up each morning. The redesigned Leisure Lounge System features dual reclining chairs, an updated dinette table system, and a panoramic window for great outdoor views. The swivel captain's seats can turn around to become part of the living area during the day, and you'll find plenty of storage space throughout for all your belongings. The galley includes a convection microwave, a flush mount LP cooktop, plus a convenient garbage can and stainless steel backsplash for easy clean-up. With any Leisure Travel Wonder Class B+ gas motorhome, the construction includes vacuum bonded aluminum framed insulated contoured sidewalls and a domed roof with fiberglass exterior, and a floor with composite exterior on a Ford Transit dual rear wheel chassis. Some highlights include the 16' heavy-duty forged aluminum alloy wheels, the auto high-beam headlamps, and the advance active safety features. The interior offers the SYNC 4 navigation system, curved soft close overhead cabinetry doors with hidden catches, full extension ball bearing soft close drawer tracks, LED aisle lighting and above cabinet hidden accent lights, and tile look vinyl flooring throughout for style and easy care. Optional AWD is available, along with the optional 60th Anniversary Edition decor and exterior color, solar panels for off-grid capability, a battery upgrade, and more!
